title: partner-cloud-marketplace-weekly-sync-prep-jamie-2026-04-06
content:
Weekly partners/cloud marketplace sync - prep notes (Jamie)
Date: 2026-04-06
Time: 10:00am PT
Attendees: Jamie Chen (me), Alex Gomez (GTM), Priya Nair (Solutions Eng), Sam Ortiz (BizDev), Jim Park (AWS partner rep - TBD), Maria Lopez (GCP rep - TBD)

Objectives:
- Align on immediate unblockers for AWS Marketplace SaaS onboarding (metering + billing tests)
- Status check for GCP Private Catalog integration pilot with Acme Corp
- Confirm Azure SaaS offer QA window and contract signature timeline
- Agree next steps for reseller/channel enablement (2-3 pilot partners)

Agenda (30-40m):
1) Quick status round (5m) - each partner highlight 1 risk + 1 win
2) AWS marketplace (10m)
   - Billing/metering testing: current failures in subscription events (see PR #78)
   - AMI vs. SaaS offer decision for dedicated deployments (ask AWS rep about support windows)
   - Required docs for listing: updated security questionnaire + architecture diagram (need final by 4/12)
3) GCP private catalog (8m)
   - Pilot with Acme Corp: onboarding checklist; network/VPC peering step is failing (network team looped)
   - Service account roles: confirm minimal set for deployment automation
4) Azure marketplace (7m)
   - QA pass scheduled 4/10-4/11; ask QA team to prioritize token billing scenario (Sam)
   - Plan for promo/offer page copy & screenshots (marketing input by 4/9)
5) Channel/reseller pilots (5m)
   - Identify 2 partners to start enablement (EMEA partner and APAC partner). Priya to share playbook draft.
6) AOB + action review (5m)

Prep notes / context (things to remind partners):
- AWS: resolving the meter event duplication issue (root cause likely double-ack on the callback). Link to debug thread: slack:#infra-alerts (thread ts: 1712000000.000100)
- GCP: earlier pilot had an IAM misconfiguration; we've prepared a hardened role set (Confluence page linked above)
- Azure: need to validate SAS token rotation for telemetry export before QA pass

Key questions to ask partners in the meeting:
- AWS: Are there any upcoming changes to their SaaS metering API in Q2 that would affect our integration?
- GCP: Can they provide a contact for the Private Catalog entitlement team to accelerate billing integration?
- Azure: Anything on their side blocking offer publication (legal/compliance steps we should pre-submit)?

Action items (owner - due):
- Fix AWS metering duplication bug and run full billing test suite - Alex Gomez - due 2026-04-09
- Finalize security/arch diagram for AWS listing and upload to confluence - Jamie Chen - due 2026-04-12
- Network/VPC peering triage for GCP pilot; provide network runbook - Priya Nair - due 2026-04-08
- Prepare Azure QA token billing test cases and confirm with QA team - Sam Ortiz - due 2026-04-09
- Share reseller enablement playbook draft and sample offer template - Priya Nair - due 2026-04-10
- Create customer-facing onboarding checklist (one-pager) for marketplace offers - Jamie Chen - due 2026-04-13

Notes for follow-up doc / PRs:
- Link PR for AWS billing fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-integration/pull/78 (leave note to include test coverage for duplicate callback)
- Create a short doc for partners: "Marketplace quickstart for channel partners" - draft in GDrive under users/jamie/ (todo)
- Add a Jira ticket to track marketing collateral: JIRA: PM-350 (create screenshots + copy for Azure offer)

Risks / blockers:
- If AWS metering regression persists, it will block go-live for any SaaS offers that rely on usage metering (impact = delayed revenue recognition). Contingency: temporary manual reconciliation workflow - Ops needs runbook.
- GCP network peering delays could postpone pilot; escalate to infra leadership if not resolved by 4/08.

Meeting follow-up template (post-meeting email):
- Quick summary of decisions (1-2 bullets)
- Action items w/ owners & due dates (copy from this doc)
- Links to artifacts: Confluence, PRs, Jira (include any new tickets created during the meeting)
- Schedule next sync: propose weekly same time until offers published

Quick scratchpad (notes I expect to capture during the call):
- AWS: Jim asked for timeline on AMI deliverable -> share ETA 4/20 for initial AMI
- GCP: Maria to intro Private Catalog entitlement lead (action: Jamie to follow up after meeting)
- Azure: Sam to confirm QA token test pass by 4/11

TODO (personal):
- Prep 2 slides for the call: 1) current status dashboard (billing success rate, listing checklist) 2) blockers & ask list (10-15m prep) - finish by EOD 4/05
- Update Confluence with AMI vs SaaS pros/cons table (short) - Jamie Chen - target 4/07

End of prep notes.
__notes: informal scratchpad style; will tidy into post-meeting summary and send to partners.
